other_conditions: Student must be from a family of weavers who are members of Primary Weaver Cooperative Societies affiliated to the State Handloom Union, Raipur
Student’s mother or father must be a regular member of a weaver cooperative society
Student must have secured admission in the first year of Engineering, Medical, CA, or MBA course in any government college
More than 50% of the parent’s income should be from weaving
Weaver family includes husband, wife, and their children
benefits_summary: A financial incentive of ₹20,000 is provided as an encouragement award for the first year of the course.
